purpose: Verify a selected installable package from prospectively frozen Git source without replacing the engineering repository or historical whole-repository release gates.

exclusion_rationale.examples/README.md: Internal campaign preparation notes are not runtime package inputs.
exclusion_rationale.src/solveur/verification/j2_multifamily_: Internal WP13 harness; no public import depends on it. Existing solver kernels and public APIs remain selected.

gates: Exact clean source/contract/tool provenance before any build
Every selected source byte covered by sdist and every runtime/resource byte covered by wheel
Strict existing scans report zero findings in selected sources, wheel and sdist
No undeclared archive payload, symlink, traversal or case alias
Unchanged package metadata version 0.2.8 in both archives
Separate venv install with no index and no dependency installation
Installed QF source SHA-256 identities match all selected source inputs
All three installed CLI version commands and primary CLI help succeed
Fresh installed verify-all probes from both unrelated cwd and source checkout cwd return 2, produce no requested report and no Python subprocess audit events
Actual argv/PID/UTC/exit codes and raw hashed command logs, plus binary manifest
limitations: Candidate package only; no release 0.2.9, tag, upload, governing merge/push or point attribution.
The whole engineering repository and Git history remain outside this selected publication decision; their historical strict-scan failures remain open.
Selected public documentation is limited to the included README, changelog, citation and selected qualification metadata; the excluded full documentation collection is not certified.
System and user dependency sites are allowed; all QF loaded module origins and installed byte hashes must still be verified. This is not full dependency isolation.
Python audit hooks are not a system-wide OS subprocess trace.
Build uses installed build dependencies with --no-isolation; actual runtime versions must be recorded.
No numerical solve, mesh refinement, independent FEM comparison or historical raw recovery is performed by this package campaign.
No existing output directory may be reused; failed attempts and all earlier raw evidence remain intact.
